title: The Iran War is Flipping | Warning.
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Thinks the US now has the upper hand (blockade working, Iran oil exports collapsing) and a nuclear deal with Iran is likely before the midterms.
Gulf oil exports are ~70-100% back to pre-war levels while Iran exports less than a tenth; Iran's grip on Hormuz is loosening.
Yields fell after the jobs report then rose intraday; no sustained decline in the 10-year until an Iran deal is actually reached.

calls.condition: Move past 800 framed as following an Iran nuclear deal
calls.reason: Near-term 750 QQQ target already hit ahead of schedule without an Iran deal; a deal would push it much higher.
calls.quote: we hit our all-time high target and we don't even have a deal yet on Iran. Imagine when we get the deal. This is going …

calls.condition: Meaningful decline in the 10-year only once an Iran deal is reached
calls.reason: Yields tend to rise intraday and the Iran war is not over, so he bet yields rise again near term; a deal would let yields stay meaningfully lower.
calls.quote: I sent a trade alert on this bet this morning that treasury yields would likely go up again before they come down
